title: Agent-Based Modelling Meets Generative AI in Social Network Simulations

bias_targets.methodology: Simulating social media users during the 2020 US election to evaluate whether LLM agents faithfully retain assigned political affiliations (Republican vs. Democrat) and analyzing homophily, content similarity, and controversy metrics to detect ideological echo chambers.

Comparing agent interactions under preference-based versus random recommendation strategies to measure the recommendation system's impact on network polarization, user engagement, and the formation of isolated ideological clusters.
